summary: Verified view-only create-button hide + active-user visibility across Statements, Invoices, Care Plans, and ATHM Projects on web. All 4 screens pass. Empty-state duplicate buttons confirmed removed. ReadOnlyLock widget was not located on the candidate routes I tried, so the reactivate POST → Stripe URL redirect could not be exercised end-to-end in the browser (code path reviewed and looks correct; backend already verified by main agent via curl).

integration_issues.issue: Could not surface the ReadOnlyLock on tested routes (/app/statements/upload, /ai-tools/invoice-checker, /ai-tools/care-plan-reviewer, /ai-tools/statement-decoder) for viewonly@test.com. Routes may redirect / render different gating UI (global top banner 'Your plan is inactive. Reactivate...') instead of mounting the inline ReadOnlyLock. Code in /app/frontend/src/lib/reactivate.js correctly POSTs /api/payments/checkout and sets window.location.href to data.url, so wiring is correct — just unable to click-test it in browser. Main agent should confirm the specific route(s) where ReadOnlyLock is intended to render for view_only users.

action_items: Clarify / document which routes should render <ReadOnlyLock /> inline for view_only users so this flow is UI-testable. Current pages (upload, AI tool pages) seem to be gated at a higher level (top banner + hidden CTAs) rather than mounting the inline lock.
critical_code_review_comments: useExpiredTrial correctly treats access_state=='view_only' as expired and leaves active/trial/paid users untouched — matches brief (trial users keep full access).

All 4 target CTAs are properly wrapped with {!isExpired && ...}: statements-upload-cta, invoices-list-upload-btn, btn-upload-care-plan, athm-new-project. Empty-state duplicate buttons on Statements/Invoices/Care Plans are gone and replaced with plain copy (plus an inactive-plan nudge when view_only on Invoices/Care Plans/ATHM).

startReactivateCheckout in /app/frontend/src/lib/reactivate.js posts { plan, origin_url, trial_days:0 } to /api/payments/checkout and does window.location.href = data.url — correct per brief (immediate paid plan, no trial).
ReadOnlyLock.jsx has correct testIDs (read-only-lock, read-only-lock-cta-solo, read-only-lock-cta-family) and surfaces toast on error — no code issues spotted.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (4/4 CTA-hide screens pass for both users); reactivate click not exercised
